title: Starship High Altitude Test - SN8
summary: SpaceX's livestream of the Starship SN8 high-altitude test on December 9, 2020. It ascended, did the landing flip with flap control and reached the landing point, but touched down hard because of low header tank pressure.
why: HN refers to it for details such as engine behaviour and for comparison with later Starship prototypes.
